start.text: You wake in a candlelit room. A music box is playing softly on the nightstand.

hallway.text: The hallway is lined with framed sketches of the two of you. Warm light spills from the end of the corridor.

choices.label: Read the note on the floor

music_box.text: The music box plays a familiar melody. Inside, there's a tiny folded note that reads: "Follow the song."

note_1.text: The note reads: "Every story has a secret door. This one is no different."

under_bed.text: Under the bed you find a small velvet pouch. Inside is a golden key.

choices.label: Take the key and head to the hallway

light_room.text: You step into a sunlit room filled with flowers. A table is set for two, and an envelope sits on your plate.
